name: wheelhouse
description: Squeekchain Sepolia v6 and v9: equal-profile reads and unsigned preparations. Reads are permissionless; owner actions are prepared as unsigned transactions for the owner's wallet to sign. Testnet only.
safety: all deployed-profile operations fail closed on same-block chain, identity, runtime hash or wiring mismatch; two RPC block hashes must agree
read ownership live, immediately before an owner action
type BURN-<donor> before constructing merge calldata; donor is permanently destroyed
this server never holds or requests a private key

tools.name: squeek_network_status
tools.description: Network-wide SqueekCore + SqueekMining state: settled round, Squeek block height, checkpoint lag, emission per day, total power, minted/supply cap, level table and whether a checkpoint can advance now. Emission fields are null (unavailable), never zero, when the chain does not publish them.

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_verify
tools.description: At one cross-checked Sepolia snapshot block, verify the selected contract graph (chain ID, implementation address, runtime hash, layout digest, proxy admin/owner, implementation version, configuration) and the wiring between SqueekCore, SqueekMining, SqueekToken and SqueekNFT. Run this before trusting any other result.

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_wallet_status
tools.description: Per-address holdings: live Squeek positions (level, active/pending power, merge cooldown block), claimable SQK, total power, network share and estimated SQK/day. Defaults to the connected wallet in the browser. sharePercent and estimatedSqkPerDay are null (unavailable), never zero.

owner.description: 0x address to inspect (optional in the browser: defaults to the connected wallet)

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_checkpoint_preview
tools.description: Whether checkpoint() can advance now (corePaused / roundSettled), with the reason when it cannot, the unsigned transaction after simulation. checkpoint() is permissionless: no Squeek needed, no caller reward.

from.description: 0x caller address for same-block checkpoint simulation (optional only for connected browser wallet)

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_claim_preview
tools.description: Simulated owner claim: actual payout and unsigned transactions. NFT batches on v6; account rewards on v9. Signs nothing.

tokenIds.description: subset of token IDs to claim (optional; default all owned)

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_merge_plan
tools.description: Same-level merge pairs that satisfy every onchain precondition (below max level, no pending activation, cooldown measured in completed Squeek blocks), with power before/after and the gain. Merging always burns the donor.

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_merge_preview
tools.description: Simulate one merge for a survivor/donor pair: resulting level and an explicit irreversibility warning. Signs nothing.

survivor.description: token ID that keeps its identity

confirm.description: must equal BURN-<donor> before building calldata

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_art
tools.description: Onchain DotGrid art and traits for a Squeek token: name, description, trait list and an SVG data URI rendered by the contract. Display it as an isolated image, never as inline markup.

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_prepare_checkpoint
tools.description: Simulate checkpoint and return an unsigned transaction for the caller wallet. Never signs or submits.

from.description: 0x caller address for same-block checkpoint simulation (optional only for connected browser wallet)

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_prepare_claim
tools.description: Simulate and prepare unsigned claims for the owner wallet: NFT batches or account rewards, according to the selected deployment.

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

tools.name: squeek_prepare_merge
tools.description: Return an unsigned merge() transaction for a survivor/donor pair plus the warning that the donor is burned permanently. Requires confirm: 'BURN-<donor>'.

confirm.description: must equal BURN-<donor> to acknowledge the burn

profile.description: Deployment for this call; defaults to the active browser profile or MCP session default

maxFee.description: Previous unstake quote cap in base units
